dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing observed from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical lateral margins with a more pronounced convex curve on the right side relative to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light gray median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency dark pixel clusters localized on the cephalic region and along the dorsal midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the light-toned baseline and the darker mottled regions.
